items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: That's the recording that I made on there. I was playing banjo on that record. And this note here says that Guy Kelly was trumpet. And Abbey Foster drums had replaced.

ctx.x: He was from St. Louis though. Definitely. He's working in the post office in St. Louis. He's a clerk in the post office and he's still playing and he's still arranging. He was a very fine arranger.

Do you remember records that you might have made with him? This Ty Ty Daddy, I remember that, Sweetheart of TKO. That's the recording that I made on there. I was playing banjo on that record. And this note here says that Guy Kelly was trumpet. And Abbey Foster drums had replaced. Yeah, he replaced .
Who had replaced Alexis? Maybe Guy Kelly had replaced Alexis had been there before do you know? at least Alexis had been there before, do you know?
